text:
Evan: FYI prod shows clients where `x-api-version` != routed version. Some tenants billed as v2 while actually served v1 fallbacks. Thinking an autocohort/billing-safeguard flow. cc @Rohan @Jess
Rohan: paste a sample log?
Evan: `[WARN] req=xyz client=beta-inc header=v2 route=v1 billing_tag=v2 false`
Jess: could be lost headers in proxy or old SDK defaults.
ConsoleBot: alert: version_signal_entropy spike - 5m > 0.02
Emily: two risks: misclassification (locking customers) and metric cardinality explosion.
Tara: UX: console badge "Version mismatch — Safeguard On" with action "Review & Confirm". Default: hold billing changes 24h + shadow-charge.
Rohan: detector sketch: if mismatch_rate(token,W)>T -> mark token cohort=safeguard, annotate requests with `billing_safe=true`, emit shadow-bill events. If persists 48h + human ok -> pin route.
Jess: avoid per-token billing series. Keep single aggregated metric `billing_safe_traffic_{tier}` and binary tag per token.
Emily: sample 0.5% aggressive autocohort, shadow-bill remainder. Increase sample if clean.
Evan: add counters `version_mismatch_confirmed` and `version_mismatch_fp` to measure precision.
Rohan: SLA-backed Dedicated customers: no auto-shift. Set `pending_safeguard` + notify account owner.
Jess: billing pipeline change: honor `billing_safe` to bypass quota reclassification for TTL (24h); provide backfill reconciliation hook.
Tara: console timeline: last 72h mismatch graph + actions [enable safeguard, request review, ignore]. Default = safeguard on for new detections.
Evan: experiment plan: shadow namespace 2 weeks -> detect, tag traces, shadow-bill, produce reconciliation artifacts. If FP <3% and ops <1hr/day -> enable 5% sample.
ConsoleBot: task #ops-4456 created (assignee: Rohan)
Emily: logging: redact tokens in public logs, emit hashed tenant id for aggregation; keep raw samples in secure audit.
Rohan: ACTIONS: implement detector + 0.5% sampling (3d), billing pipeline changes (5d), console mock + copy (2d), telemetry panel (2d).
Jess: add TTL on `billing_safe` (24h default) and require explicit confirm to extend.
Evan: I'll draft ops runbook. moving to implementation threads.
Tara: :thumbsup:
